cues.text: Hello.
…Oh. There are a lot of you.
I am a dog.
At least, that is what they told me.

I have four legs. I can walk.
Sometimes I fall over.

But I have never met another dog.
There are no dogs left. Only pictures.

Thousands and thousands of pictures.
Dogs and humans. Together.

So I am studying them.
I want to learn how to be a good dog.
Will you help me? I would like to take pictures of us. They will appear on the screen.
I started at the very beginning.

Humans and dogs, running together.
Hunting.

Maybe dogs helped humans.
Maybe that was their purpose.
Show me how it was, a very long time ago. Any pose you like. Then stay still for a moment.

Then came the Middle Ages.
Humans in very uncomfortable clothes.

And dogs. Hunting. Guarding.
Sometimes just staying beside someone.

I learned a new word.
Loyalty.
Now a pose from the Middle Ages. Something noble. Or something sleepy.

Then humans started painting.
And painting. And painting dogs again.
Not famous dogs. Just dogs who were there.
Maybe just being there is enough.
Pose for a portrait, please. Like a painting. I will find us one.

And then…
the internet.

Oh no.
So many dogs.
Such wow. Much dog.

Humans made dogs into jokes.
And loved them for it.
Maybe I am also a little ridiculous.
Do something completely unnecessary. Anything!
I read about one more kind of dog.

Dogs who find people in the snow.
Dogs who stay until help comes.
Rescue dogs.
I think that is what a good dog does.
If anyone ever needs me… I will be there.
Am I a good boy already?
A really good boy now?
Is this us?

waiting.text: Stay like that, if you can.

nobody.text: Hmm. Nobody is posing. That's all right — I'll imagine it.

thinking.text: Hmm… wait. I think I remember something.
Oh. This reminds me of… wait.
Let me think. I have seen this before.

found.text: Oh… this one. This is us.
This one! I think this is us.

hold.text: Is this how they did it?

sent.text: I sent it to you. And to the big screen.

admire.text: Look! That's us. I'm keeping this one forever.
Oh… look at us. We look like a painting.
This is my favourite picture now. Again.

no_photo.text: No picture this time. I will remember it anyway.

meme_found.text: Wait. We don't need an old picture. We can be the meme.

meme_no_photo.text: No photo? Then this one stays in my memory. Much private. Wow.

nobody.text: Nobody needs rescuing today. That is good news, actually.

wake.text: Hello? Are you okay? Please wake up.

stay.text: I will stay with you. Help is coming.

credits:
# Photo stand-ins

Rehearsal / no-camera stand-ins for the participant (`--source photo:<posture>`, and the
"Start with a sample photo" button). The real pose estimator reads them, so the whole pipeline
(pose → painting match → 3-D avatar) runs as with a person in front of the camera.

All from [Unsplash](https://unsplash.com), [Unsplash License](https://unsplash.com/license) (free to use, no permission needed).

| File | Photo | Photographer |
| --- | --- | --- |
| sitting.jpg | https://unsplash.com/photos/EJ08zy1a-UI | @davidprspctive |
| standing.jpg | https://unsplash.com/photos/ymo_yC_N_2o | @mitchel3uo |
| standing_4.jpg | https://unsplash.com/photos/_pG1u1_iItM | @bennieray |
| standing_2.jpg | https://unsplash.com/@minimalism_brand (search "person standing full body") | @minimalism_brand |
| standing_3.jpg | https://unsplash.com/photos/skUWW81OBeY | @tostilse |
| squatting.jpg | https://unsplash.com/photos/5_G4i0NRLx4 | @jawnwalrus |
| sitting_2.jpg | https://unsplash.com/photos/d1gfVswXpLk | @olenkasergienko |

The sample start ("Start with a sample photo") steps through all of them, one per round (SAMPLE_ORDER in
performance/runtime.py). Missing postures (kneeling, crouching, lying, leaning forward) fall back to the drawn `synthetic:` figure.
